name: Solid 4-2-3-1

slots.why: Distributes safely and simply, avoiding risks in the build-up.
No-nonsense full-back defends first and clears his lines, staying out of the attack.
Central defender. Cover is the alternate.
Central defender on the right. Cover is the alternate, but only one Cover can be used.
No-nonsense full-back on the right, doing the same job as on the left.
Holding midfielder screens the defence and does the simple defensive work.
Supporting midfielder wins the ball and passes it to the attacking players.
Inside forward (Support) cuts in to support the striker and works back when the ball is lost.
Attacking midfielder (Support) links midfield and attack and drops back to help.
Winger (Support) provides the width on the right and tracks back.
Complete forward (Support) holds the ball up and links with the attacking midfielders.

description: A cautious 4-2-3-1 with no-nonsense full-backs, a double pivot, and attacking players who work back.
whyGood: The team has ten players behind the ball, the full-backs simply defend, and the front four still give the team a quick way out.
whyThisShape: The no-nonsense full-backs and double pivot give two layers of protection in front of the goalkeeper, and the attacking midfielders work back to form a compact block. Up front, the striker holds the ball and the inside forward and winger break to support him, so the team can get out of pressure without being stretched.
whenToUse: Away against a stronger team or when you are protecting a lead, when you want a low-risk shape that can still hit on the break.
whenNotToUse: When you need to control the ball or create chances, since the full-backs and pivot offer little going forward.

instructionRationale.Lower Line of Engagement: Lets the opponent have the ball in their own half and closes the space deeper.
instructionRationale.Standard Defensive Line: A balanced line keeps the block compact without dropping too deep.
instructionRationale.Regroup: Falls back into shape after losing the ball.
instructionRationale.Hold Shape: Keeps positions rather than pushing players forward, so the team stays compact.
instructionRationale.Slightly More Direct Passing: Gets the ball forward to the front four quickly when it is won.

keyRequirements: Two defensive full-backs who clear their lines
An inside forward who works back
A striker who holds up the ball
